branches.delta: DB access is an effect/authority path: semantic intent and transaction plan may be model/Clay-visible, but host resource authority remains external and use-time checked.
Compile-first BASE direction retained. Current G9 spec/grammar conformance remains a separate blocking work item; APP-03 does not justify new core semantics.
Graph activation/selection remains relevance state and cannot mint database authority. Exact DB transaction semantics stay outside activation.

APP-03 supports U2's separation of semantic identity, transaction domain and physical placement. Typed adapter lowering can preserve a logical Clay contract while SQLite owns concrete transaction machinery.
DB commit receipts are downstream effect evidence, not workspace uptake or GWT causal-use evidence.
No topology primitive is required by the tested exact transaction path.
Transaction success/rollback is runtime evidence only and is not emergence or consciousness evidence.
Future H2/BASE differential tests should compare transaction commit/rollback, parameter binding and adapter authority across backends.

Focused APP-03 source -> parsed subset -> canonical IR -> deterministic lowering -> real SQLite adapter execution supports implementation/FFI work over language redesign for the tested CRUD/transaction class.
